title: On the top of the Howth tram alone crying to the rain: Naked women! naked women! What about that, eh?
html_source: The life instinct makes few interjections at this point in the text. Stephen’s libido is referred to in jest through Uncle Richie, “On the Howth tram alone shouting to the rain: naked women! What about that eh?”
